caption: Step 1: every list in a page has a head. Click Filter (it says Filter, with its icon) to open the menu.
Step 2: the Filter menu, each choice with a short line saying what it is. Your own properties (columns you added with + Property) are listed under their own heading.
Pick Status: its values as a checklist with how many pages hold each. Ticking Open applies at once: the list narrows behind the menu and the chip appears. The four ways read in plain words.
What the four ways mean, each with an example from the same list of six pages.
Click a chip to change it: the same picker opens under the chip, with is, is not, is not set and is set.
× on a chip takes that filter away; the list widens at once and focus moves to the next chip, or to Filter.
Many filters at the full width: the chips wrap onto a second line; nothing is squeezed or hidden, and Add filter and Clear all stay at the end.
Clear takes every filter away; the list shows all its pages again and the search words, if any, stay.
Two filters: a page must match both. The head counts what is shown, 2 of 6 pages.
Edited or Written: fixed choices only — Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last year, Any time. No typed dates.
Search this list: the only typed field. Its words narrow the list together with the chips, and Esc empties it.
The same chips on every view. On a Board grouped by Status, a column whose pages are all filtered out shows its heading with 0 and stays, so a card can still be dragged into it.
Nothing matches: one quiet line and Clear filters, in the list's own place; the chips stay so one can be changed.
Monday: two filters are added to the list in the Zeal page. The page keeps them as it keeps your words; there is nothing to save.
Tuesday: open the Zeal page again and the same two chips are on its list, showing the same 3 of 6 pages.
A filter whose value is gone (its folder deleted, a property removed): the chip shows the value struck and 'gone'; the list ignores it; × takes it away. Nothing is changed on disk until then.
Step 1: the Questions list is at the foot of the side list, above Margin notes. Click Questions.
Step 2: the Questions list. All, Question and Answered stay as built; Add filter beside them adds a Folder or Book chip from the same picker.
Ctrl+K: the same chips under the search field narrow the one search — a kind (Pages, Questions, Key points, Notes, Folders) and a folder. Esc clears the words first, then closes.

An opened folder holding about a hundred saves of every kind: grouped by kind with counts, scrolling, with Add filter for a kind of save and a book. Here 120 saves (Salt); the Verse and Numbers chips show 18 of them.
Phone: the list's head has a clear Filter button with its count, the chips are big buttons that wrap onto as many lines as they need, and nothing runs off the screen.
Phone: tapping a chip or Filter opens a bottom sheet with big rows, the four ways as buttons, and Done; the list behind narrows as you tick.
Folder: the folder a page is in. A list that gathers pages from several folders can be narrowed to one or more of them.
Status: a column you add yourself with + Property, such as Open and Done for a study you are still working on. Status means only what you make it mean; the app never sets it.
Edited and Written: Edited is when the page was last changed; Written is when it was first made. Both pick from fixed choices: Today, Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last year.
Book: the books of the Bible a page names in its references and Scripture blocks. A page that names Numbers and Psalms is found under both.
Callout kind: the callouts written in a page: Question, Answered, Key point or Note. A page with a question still open shows under Question.
Your own properties: any column you added to the list with + Property (here Speaker, for lessons taught by different people). It is offered in the Filter menu with the values your pages hold.
Where a list comes from: in any page, type / and pick List in a page. It is not a separate place; any page can hold one.
Then pick which folder's pages it lists. The list shows those pages; its head carries the view, Search and Filter. 'All study pages' in these frames is such a list, placed in a page of that name.
